answer: Each identity must hold a licensed bail bondsman registration, earned with a fingerprint background check, a surety bond and a licensing exam costing about $300 per candidate. A farm needs a distinct licensed bondsman per fake, so 1,000 fakes cost $300,000 plus a bond each. The shale of cheap aliases cracks: every fake adds another exam, the falcon of the background check spots shared fingerprints, and the orchard of fake bondsmen withers under renewal fees.
